title: New Service Desk Rule: Connection, Transfer and Same-Day Fees on Electric Service by Rate Schedule
content:
**Fees on opening.** Opening an Electric Service by Rate Schedule account bills the schedule's service connection fee for new construction or a returning member, and the schedule's transfer fee for a transfer of an energized location into a different member's name.

**Same-day connect.** A connect requested before 12:00 on a business day and completed the same day adds the schedule's same-day connect fee.

**Energization.** Energization of new construction waits for the line extension project to be energized under Line Extensions and New Service Construction; a transfer is energized on the requested date without a field visit.

**Billing.** The connection fee and the transfer fee are billed on the first bill.

**Name corrections.** A fee is never charged for correcting the name on an account of the same member.

### Same-day fee — boundary cases (hypothetical, request on a business day and completed that day)

| Time of request | Same-day connect fee added |
|---|---|
| 11:59 | Yes |
| 12:00 | No — the request is not before 12:00 |
| 13:30 | No |

### Opening fees by kind of opening

| Kind of opening | Fee on the first bill |
|---|---|
| New construction | Service connection fee |
| Returning member at a location | Service connection fee |
| Transfer of an energized location to a different member | Transfer fee |
| Correction of the name of the same member | None |
